opportunities.title: Cricket Team Management Web App Development
opportunities.description: # Project: Build a Cricket Team Management Web App — MVP ## 1. Project Overview I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build a mobile-first web application for grassroots cricket teams in India. The product will help cricket captains manage match payments, team expenses, squad selection, player availability, attendance, and cricket net practice bookings in one place. Today, captains commonly use WhatsApp groups, Google Sheets, and personal UPI accounts to coordinate matches and collect money. This creates confusion around pending payments, expenses, player availability, and team coordination. The objective is to build a simple, polished, user-friendly product that solves these recurring problems. This is an MVP intended for real-world testing with cricket teams, not a large enterprise platform. ## 2. Target Users * Cricket team captains managing approximately 10–15 players. * Players who participate in multiple teams or clubs. * Team managers coordinating matches and practice sessions. * Cricket net facility owners, in a later expansion phase. ## 3. Core Features Required ### A. User Authentication and Team Management * Sign-up, login, and user profiles. * Create a cricket team or join through an invitation link. * Add, edit, and remove players. * Assign captain and player roles. * Support players belonging to multiple teams. * Share team invitations through WhatsApp or a shareable link. ### B. Match Management and Squad Selection * Create matches with date, time, venue, and match contribution. * Track player availability and participation confirmations. * Select squads for individual matches. * Maintain player roles, skill categories, substitutes, and selection status. * Publish squads and share match information. * Record attendance and maintain match history. ### C. Payment Collection and Financial Tracking This is the primary feature and must receive particular attention. * Create match-wise payment requests. * Split contributions equally or assign custom amounts. * Track paid, pending, partially paid, and waived amounts. * Display total expected collections, collected amounts, and outstanding dues. * Provide UPI payment instructions or payment links where supported. * Allow players to report payments and captains to verify them. * Record payment references, expenses, refunds, and adjustments. * Maintain a separate financial ledger for each team and match. * Display expense breakdowns and downloadable financial summaries. * Provide reminders for outstanding contributions. The system must distinguish player-reported payments from captain-verified payments. Do not claim automatic payment verification without a real integration. ### D. Cricket Nets Discovery and Booking Add a basic cricket practice management module. * Display nearby cricket net facilities in a searchable list. * Show facility name, location, distance, indicative hourly price, and available amenities. * Allow captains to select a facility, date, time, duration, and number of nets. * Create team practice sessions and invite players. * Track attendance confirmations and actual attendance. * Calculate each player's contribution toward the practice cost. * Track nets fees, pending payments, and expenses separately from match fees. * Allow booking requests to be confirmed manually by the facility or administrator. For the MVP, a curated facility directory and manual booking confirmation are acceptable. Real-time availability, automated reservations, and a full facility-owner marketplace can be developed later. ### E. Player Dashboard * Upcoming matches and practice sessions. * Personal payment dues and transaction history. * Squad selection and availability status. * Attendance records. * Expense transparency and team announcements. * A simple view for switching between multiple teams. ### F. Notifications and Gamification * Basic in-app notifications and payment reminders. * Shareable match and practice details. * Simple badges for attendance consistency and timely contributions. * Keep gamification secondary to the main functionality. ## 4. Features Outside the Initial Scope Do not build live scoring, scorecards, detailed cricket statistics, tournament management, ground booking, or complex reward systems. Do not build a digital wallet or hold customer funds. The initial product should organize payment information and facilitate existing payment methods. Automated venue integrations and advanced payment-gateway integrations are not mandatory for the MVP. ## 5. UI/UX Requirements The product must be mobile-first, responsive, and easy to navigate on Android smartphones and desktop browsers. I want a polished sports-tech design with: * Clean dashboards and clear navigation. * A modern, consistent design system. * Clear payment-status indicators. * Easy-to-understand forms and confirmation screens. * Attractive cards, typography, icons, and empty states. * A professional visual identity suitable for a commercial product. Please avoid generic admin-dashboard templates. The experience should be designed specifically for Indian grassroots cricket teams. ## 6. Technical Requirements I am open to recommendations for the technology stack. A suitable approach could include React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase or an equivalent backend. The solution should provide: * Secure authentication and appropriate access controls. * A structured database for users, teams, matches, bookings, payments, expenses, and attendance. * Consistent financial calculations and transaction records. * Responsive frontend components. * Maintainable, documented code. * Secure handling of user information. * A deployment process suitable for ongoing development. Use mock data or simulated actions where external integrations are not available. Clearly identify all simulated functionality. ## 7. Expected Deliverables 1. A functional, deployed web application. 2. All agreed MVP screens and user workflows. 3. Frontend and backend source code. 4. Database schema and setup documentation. 5. Deployment and configuration documentation. 6. Testing of the agreed primary workflows. 7. Responsive mobile and desktop layouts. 8. Source code repository and ownership transferred to me. 9. Handover of project accounts, credentials, and environment configuration. 10. A defined post-launch bug-fix period. All code, designs, and project deliverables must be transferred to me upon completion and payment according to the agreed milestones. ## 8. Budget and Timeline My budget is open to proposals based on the actual scope and implementation approach. Please provide separate estimates for: * Phase 1: Core team management, match payments, expenses, and attendance. * Phase 2: Nets discovery, booking requests, practice attendance, and nets-fee tracking. * Optional Phase 3: Automated bookings, payment integrations, and advanced features. Please specify the development timeline, total cost, assumptions, third-party charges, and any features excluded from your quotation. I prefer milestone-based payments tied to working deliverables and demonstrations. ## 9. What to Include in Your Proposal Please answer the following: 1. Share two or three relevant projects you have built, preferably SaaS, marketplace, booking, or payment-tracking applications. 2. What technology stack would you recommend, and why? 3. How would you implement the financial ledger and payment-status workflow? 4. How would you implement nearby net discovery and manual booking confirmation? 5. What is your estimated cost and timeline for each phase? 6. What is included in your quotation, and what would cost extra? 7. Will I receive the complete source code and deployment access? 8. What post-launch maintenance and bug-fix support do you provide? I am looking for a developer who can think beyond coding, recommend practical solutions, communicate clearly, and build a reliable MVP that can be tested with real users. Please prioritize a working, maintainable product over unnecessary complexity. I am open to reducing scope if it helps launch faster without compromising the core user experience.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "# Project: Build a Cricket Team Management Web App — MVP ## 1. Project Overview I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build a mobile-first web application for grassroots cricket teams in India. The product will help cricket captains manage match payments, team expenses, squad selection, player availability, attendance, and cricket net practice bookings in one place. Today, captains commonly use WhatsApp groups, Google Sheets, and personal UPI accounts to coordinate matches and collect money. This creates confusion around pending payments, expenses, player availability, and team coordination. The objective is to build a simple, polished, user-friendly product that solves these recurring problems. This is an MVP intended for real-world testing with cricket teams, not a large enterprise platform. ## 2. Target Users * Cricket team captains managing approximately 10–15 players. * Players who participate in multiple teams or clubs. * Team managers coordinating matches and practice sessions. * Cricket net facility owners, in a later expansion phase. ## 3. Core Features Required ### A. User Authentication and Team Management * Sign-up, login, and user profiles. * Create a cricket team or join through an invitation link. * Add, edit, and remove players. * Assign captain and player roles. * Support players belonging to multiple teams. * Share team invitations through WhatsApp or a shareable link. ### B. Match Management and Squad Selection * Create matches with date, time, venue, and match contribution. * Track player availability and participation confirmations. * Select squads for individual matches. * Maintain player roles, skill categories, substitutes, and selection status. * Publish squads and share match information. * Record attendance and maintain match history. ### C. Payment Collection and Financial Tracking This is the primary feature and must receive particular attention. * Create match-wise payment requests. * Split contributions equally or assign custom amounts. * Track paid, pending, partially paid, and waived amounts. * Display total expected collections, collected amounts, and outstanding dues. * Provide UPI payment instructions or payment links where supported. * Allow players to report payments and captains to verify them. * Record payment references, expenses, refunds, and adjustments. * Maintain a separate financial ledger for each team and match. * Display expense breakdowns and downloadable financial summaries. * Provide reminders for outstanding contributions. The system must distinguish player-reported payments from captain-verified payments. Do not claim automatic payment verification without a real integration. ### D. Cricket Nets Discovery and Booking Add a basic cricket practice management module. * Display nearby cricket net facilities in a searchable list. * Show facility name, location, distance, indicative hourly price, and available amenities. * Allow captains to select a facility, date, time, duration, and number of nets. * Create team practice sessions and invite players. * Track attendance confirmations and actual attendance. * Calculate each player's contribution toward the practice cost. * Track nets fees, pending payments, and expenses separately from match fees. * Allow booking requests to be confirmed manually by the facility or administrator. For the MVP, a curated facility directory and manual booking confirmation are acceptable. Real-time availability, automated reservations, and a full facility-owner marketplace can be developed later. ### E. Player Dashboard * Upcoming matches and practice sessions. * Personal payment dues and transaction history. * Squad selection and availability status. * Attendance records. * Expense transparency and team announcements. * A simple view for switching between multiple teams. ### F. Notifications and Gamification * Basic in-app notifications and payment reminders. * Shareable match and practice details. * Simple badges for attendance consistency and timely contributions. * Keep gamification secondary to the main functionality. ## 4. Features Outside the Initial Scope Do not build live scoring, scorecards, detailed cricket statistics, tournament management, ground booking, or complex reward systems. Do not build a digital wallet or hold customer funds. The initial product should organize payment information and facilitate existing payment methods. Automated venue integrations and advanced payment-gateway integrations are not mandatory for the MVP. ## 5. UI/UX Requirements The product must be mobile-first, responsive, and easy to navigate on Android smartphones and desktop browsers. I want a polished sports-tech design with: * Clean dashboards and clear navigation. * A modern, consistent design system. * Clear payment-status indicators. * Easy-to-understand forms and confirmation screens. * Attractive cards, typography, icons, and empty states. * A professional visual identity suitable for a commercial product. Please avoid generic admin-dashboard templates. The experience should be designed specifically for Indian grassroots cricket teams. ## 6. Technical Requirements I am open to recommendations for the technology stack. A suitable approach could include React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase or an equivalent backend. The solution should provide: * Secure authentication and appropriate access controls. * A structured database for users, teams, matches, bookings, payments, expenses, and attendance. * Consistent financial calculations and transaction records. * Responsive frontend components. * Maintainable, documented code. * Secure handling of user information. * A deployment process suitable for ongoing development. Use mock data or simulated actions where external integrations are not available. Clearly identify all simulated functionality. ## 7. Expected Deliverables 1. A functional, deployed web application. 2. All agreed MVP screens and user workflows. 3. Frontend and backend source code. 4. Database schema and setup documentation. 5. Deployment and configuration documentation. 6. Testing of the agreed primary workflows. 7. Responsive mobile and desktop layouts. 8. Source code repository and ownership transferred to me. 9. Handover of project accounts, credentials, and environment configuration. 10. A defined post-launch bug-fix period. All code, designs, and project deliverables must be transferred to me upon completion and payment according to the agreed milestones. ## 8. Budget and Timeline My budget is open to proposals based on the actual scope and implementation approach. Please provide separate estimates for: * Phase 1: Core team management, match payments, expenses, and attendance. * Phase 2: Nets discovery, booking requests, practice attendance, and nets-fee tracking. * Optional Phase 3: Automated bookings, payment integrations, and advanced features. Please specify the development timeline, total cost, assumptions, third-party charges, and any features excluded from your quotation. I prefer milestone-based payments tied to working deliverables and demonstrations. ## 9. What to Include in Your Proposal Please answer the following: 1. Share two or three relevant projects you have built, preferably SaaS, marketplace, booking, or payment-tracking applications. 2. What technology stack would you recommend, and why? 3. How would you implement the financial ledger and payment-status workflow? 4. How would you implement nearby net discovery and manual booking confirmation? 5. What is your estimated cost and timeline for each phase? 6. What is included in your quotation, and what would cost extra? 7. Will I receive the complete source code and deployment access? 8. What post-launch maintenance and bug-fix support do you provide? I am looking for a developer who can think beyond coding, recommend practical solutions, communicate clearly, and build a reliable MVP that can be tested with real users. Please prioritize a working, maintainable product over unnecessary complexity. I am open to reducing scope if it helps launch faster without compromising the core user experience."

opportunities.title: Mechanical Engineer Needed to Finalise Consumer Product Design (STP to Production-Ready CAD)
opportunities.description: We have the core STEP files for a new consumer product. We need a manufacturing-minded Mechanical Engineer to finalize the design for prototyping and production. What you will do: • Complete the product design using our design concept. • Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM) to keep production costs low. • Turn rough concepts into clean, production-ready 3D CAD models. What we need: • Expertise in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Rhino. • Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, and manufacturing methods. • Focus on consumer safety and usability standards. Deliverables: • Native CAD files + clean STEP/STL exports for rapid prototyping. • Fully organized assemblies with clearly labeled layers. To apply: Send your portfolio showing consumer products you have successfully moved from CAD to physical prototypes.

opportunities.title: MS Teams to Zendesk Integration
opportunities.description: Brief: Teams Customer Chasers → Zendesk Automation Oct 21, 2026 · @Edwin Objective Automatically turn customer chasers posted in Microsoft Teams group chats into tracked, prioritised actions on the matching Zendesk ticket. Agents keep working only from Zendesk; Teams becomes one more signal feeding the operational queue. Today, chasers arrive in Teams and must be spotted, matched and acted on manually. The target behaviour: customer chases in Teams → the right ticket is identified from PNR, ticket number or subject → it is marked as chased → it rises in a dedicated Zendesk view. Architecture Customer chaser in Teams → automation captures message → extracts PNR / ticket no. → searches Zendesk → matches ticket → updates it via Zendesk API → native Zendesk trigger → Customer Chasers view → agent action. • Why not the standard Zendesk for Teams app: it lets agents view, create and update tickets in Teams, but does not auto-match chasers or reprioritise tickets. • Division of labour: the automation performs the external Teams → Zendesk update; native Zendesk triggers handle routing and priority afterwards. Zendesk warns against triggers calling webhooks back into the same ticket (race conditions). • Message capture: every new customer message in the relevant Teams group chats must be captured in near real time, through a dedicated operations/service Teams account that is a member of every customer chat. • Identity: OAuth credentials on a dedicated integration identity for production, never personal credentials. Zendesk setup (before building the flow) Custom field Type Purpose Teams Chaser Checkbox Flags tickets chased on Teams Teams Chaser Count Number Chaser events received Last Teams Chaser Date/time Latest chase; drives duplicate suppression Teams Match Status Dropdown Auto Matched / Manual Match / Unmatched PNR Text Matching key (confirm it already exists) Tags: teams_chaser (matched), teams_unmatched_chaser (exceptions). Add tags additively so existing tags are not overwritten. Views: • Customer Chasers — Teams Chaser = Yes. Columns: Ticket ID, Subject, PNR, Status, Assignee, Chaser Count, Last Chaser. Grouped 3+ chasers, then 1–2, then normal queue; normal SLA order within each. • Unmatched Teams Chasers — tag teams_unmatched_chaser. The safety net. Automation requirements For every new customer message, the automation must: 1. Capture the message from the customer Teams group chat as it arrives. 2. Clean it to plain text (strip Teams HTML formatting). 3. Extract the PNR: the 6 characters after PNR:, spaces removed (e.g. PNR: ENIPEC → ENIPEC). Version 1 handles explicit PNR: only. 4. Extract the ticket number after TKTN: (e.g. 978-7493167546). Keep multi-ticket strings such as 160-7363702923/21/22/24 whole for now. 5. Retain the full message text for subject/request-type matching. 6. Search Zendesk tickets for the PNR (Search API, type:ticket ). 7. Evaluate the results (0, 1 or 2+ plausible tickets) against the matching rules below. 8. Update the matched ticket via the Zendesk API: internal note ("public": false — never emailed to the customer), Teams Chaser = Yes, Chaser Count + 1, Last Teams Chaser = now, Match Status = Auto Matched, tag teams_chaser. 9. Hand over to Zendesk: a native trigger surfaces the ticket in Customer Chasers. Example note: CUSTOMER CHASER RECEIVED VIA TEAMS — PNR: ABLSJB — Customer message: Re:[Voyzant] (TIANTAI) PNR:ABLSJB, TKTN:978-7493167546, Inquiry of name correction. Matching rules Principle: when uncertain, don't guess. Key priority: Zendesk ticket # → PNR → ticket number (TKTN) → subject/request type. Situation Action PNR + exact/near-exact subject Auto match PNR + TKTN + request type Auto match PNR + TKTN, one plausible result Auto match PNR + request type, one result Auto match PNR only, multiple tickets Unmatched No PNR Unmatched Multiple plausible results Unmatched Example: PNR KCAQDG returns #18201 Refund, #18244 Involuntary Reissue, #18301 Name Correction. The chaser reads "Inquiry Involuntary Reissue" with TKTN 160-7363702923, so #18244 is selected. To raise match rates, ask customers to use a standard subject: 1589052 | PNR ABC123 | Refund Pending. Unmatched handling No confident match creates an exception ticket (POST /api/v2/tickets), so no chaser is lost. • Retry first: Zendesk search indexing can lag a few minutes. On zero results, wait 2–3 minutes and search once more before raising an exception. • Exception ticket: subject UNMATCHED TEAMS CHASER – ; internal details list PNR, TKTN, customer message, possible matches (e.g. #18201, #18244, #18301), reason, and "ACTION REQUIRED: identify the correct ticket and apply the chaser". Tag teams_unmatched_chaser. • Routing trigger: tag teams_unmatched_chaser → Group = B2B Operations / Floor Support, Priority = High. One named owner per shift. • Exception SLA: 0–5 min Match Required · 5–10 min Match Overdue · 10+ min Supervisor Alert. • Teams alert: if still unhandled, the automation posts to an internal ops group chat: PNR, customer, minutes waiting, number of possible tickets, link to the Unmatched queue. Escalation, duplicates and limitations Escalation tiers (Zendesk triggers on Chaser Count; do not set Urgent on every message): Chaser count Action 1 Tag teams_chaser 2 Appears in Customer Chasers – Priority 3 Priority = High + notify supervisor 4+ Operational escalation Duplicate suppression: if Last Teams Chaser on the same ticket is under 10 minutes old, add the note only; otherwise increment the count. Four messages in three minutes = one chaser event, each still recorded. Limitations: • Capture must cover the way customers actually chase: group chats, channel replies, shared channels and 1:1 chats may each need separate handling. • Capture only works for chats the service account belongs to. • Search index lag (see retry above). Rollout and open decisions No AI is needed for version 1. Build in three phases, proving each on test tickets before moving on. 1. Phase 1 – MVP: capture Teams message → extract PNR → search Zendesk → add internal note. 2. Phase 2 – Prioritisation: multi-ticket matching, chaser count, Zendesk views and escalation tiers. 3. Phase 3 – Safety net: unmatched workflow, search retry, exception SLA, Teams alerts, duplicate suppression. 4. Later: automated Teams acknowledgements to customers (e.g. "Chaser recorded against #1589052 · Status: Pending · Assigned: John · Chaser count: 2"), only once matching is reliable; fallback PNR detection without the PNR: prefix. Open decisions: [ ] Confirm chasers arrive via group chats (vs channels, shared channels or 1:1 chats) [ ] Provision the dedicated Teams service account and add it to all customer chats [ ] Zendesk admin to create fields, tags, views and OAuth credentials [ ] Name the per-shift owner of the Unmatched view [ ] Agree the standard customer subject format

proposal.subject: Propuesta Directa: MS Teams to Zendesk Integration
proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40779915 (Bots, WhatsApp & Automatización)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"MS Teams to Zendesk Integration"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, secaderos de café, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

blueprint.product_type: 🤖 Bot de Respuesta y Agendamiento en WhatsApp 24/7 (Plantilla n8n / WhatsApp)
blueprint.deliverable: Flujo ya armado que responde precios, envía catálogo PDF/fotos y agenda citas en Google Calendar/Sheets.
blueprint.target_audience: Clínicas odontológicas, centros de estética, barberías, inmobiliarias y tiendas en Instagram Colombia.
blueprint.suggested_pricing: COP $350.000 por dejarlo instalado + COP $80.000/mes opcional por mantenimiento.

opportunities.title: Semi-Realistic 3D Body Animations
opportunities.description: I am creating a new YouTube series and need short, semi-realistic 3D animations that focus on the human body. Each video will ultimately run 60-120 seconds, but I build them in smaller narrative beats of around 15–20 seconds, so I will pass you a clear storyboard in those chunks. You will receive: • “ChatGPT-style” reference images that capture lighting, colour palette, and general mood. I have attached one sample of what I would like animated. • A written breakdown of each shot, camera move, and timing cue. What I need from you: • 3D character animation centred on accurate yet slightly stylised human anatomy (think natural proportions with a touch of artistry, not hyper-photoreal). It must be compatible with YouTube as I will be uplaoding the animation to my channel. • Matching environments or simple props only when they help the storytelling—otherwise the focus stays on the body itself. • Delivery of each beat as its own high-resolution file (preferably .mp4) so I can assemble the final edit. • A quick sample or show-reel link that demonstrates your previous 3D work—anything with character movement, muscle deformation or expressive posing will help me gauge fit. If you work in Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D or a similar pipeline and can export cleanly to common codecs, we should be ready to start right away.

Shopify Website Design * Attractive, premium, luxury-style design. * Clean, professional layout inspired by leading Indian fashion e-commerce stores. * Fully mobile-friendly and responsive. * Easy navigation and smooth shopping experience. 2. Please Include in Your Proposal * Total project cost. * Estimated completion time. * Examples of Shopify fashion stores you have built. * Confirmation that 50 products are included. * Any additional charges, if applicable.

opportunities.title: Finite element analysis of dental models
opportunities.description: Title: 3D FEA of Removable Partial Dentures – Two-Arch Dental Model with Occlusal Contact (Research Publication) I am a prosthodontics postgraduate planning a research paper for a peer-reviewed dental journal. I am looking for an experienced FEA engineer for a biomechanical study of removable partial dentures (RPDs). AT THIS STAGE I AM COLLECTING QUOTES AND EXAMPLES ONLY. Work is expected to start in about 4–6 weeks, after my study design is finalised. WHAT I WILL PROVIDE - Intraoral scan STL files (maxilla, mandible, bite registration) - Edited models (teeth digitally removed, ridges sculpted) - CAD designs of the RPD frameworks, denture bases and teeth - Material properties and load values, with literature references SCOPE OF WORK - Build internal anatomy: tooth roots, PDL (~0.25 mm), cortical and cancellous bone, mucosa layer (~2 mm) - Two-arch model with occlusal contact between maxilla and mandible - Frictional contacts (framework–tooth, denture base–mucosa, occlusal contacts) - Meshing with a mesh convergence check - About 7–10 static analyses: 3 edentulous configurations, 2–3 framework designs, simulated denture-base settling, and mucosa stiffness sensitivity runs - Vertical and oblique loading DELIVERABLES - Von Mises stress maps with identical colour scales across all runs - Displacement results (denture bases and abutment teeth) - Occlusal contact force/pressure per tooth - Numerical result tables (peak and mean values per region) - Methods report: software and version, element type, nodes/elements, convergence result, boundary conditions, contact settings - Final model and result files - Permission to publish the results; one round of revisions if reviewers request it REQUIREMENTS - ANSYS, Abaqus or FEBio - Prior dental or biomechanical FEA experience (please share examples or published work) - Experience with nonlinear contact analysis PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR BID 1. Your price for the full scope 2. Expected timeline 3. One or two examples of similar dental/biomechanical FEA work 4. Software you will use

opportunities.title: Sean food pasta
opportunities.description: Necesito un documento claro y bien estructurado que cubra cada fase de la elaboración de una pasta con camarones y mejillones pensada para 2 personas. Quiero algo de picor moderado y usaré lingüíni como base. El entregable debe incluir: • Lista completa de ingredientes con cantidades exactas. • Tiempos y temperaturas para la cocción de la pasta, los camarones y los mejillones. • Preparación paso a paso de la salsa, indicando el punto en el que se añade el picante. • Instrucciones finales para mezclar la pasta con los mariscos y presentar el plato acabado, idealmente con sugerencias de emplatado. Prefiero un formato fácil de seguir, con secciones claras y consejos prácticos que eviten sobrecocinar los mariscos. Si puedes añadir notas de sustituciones o variaciones (por ejemplo, ajustar el nivel de picante o usar otro tipo de pasta), será un plus.

opportunities.title: 3D Teen Entertainment Cartoon Video
opportunities.description: I want to produce a fun, fast-paced 3D animated cartoon that speaks directly to teenagers. The goal is pure entertainment, so the look should be vibrant, slightly edgy, and packed with memorable characters and snappy visual gags. Here is how I see the workflow unfolding: • You and I refine the core concept together (I have a loose idea but I’m open to your creative spin). • A short script and storyboard set the tone, humour, and pacing. • Full 3D production follows: modelling, texturing, rigging, animation, lighting, and basic effects. Popular pipelines such as Blender, Maya, or Cinema 4D are all fine—use whichever lets you hit a polished, broadcast-ready finish. • Add music, sound design, and voice-over (if you can provide voices that match the teen vibe, that’s a bonus, otherwise I’ll supply recordings). • Final output in 1080p MP4 along with the source project files so future updates are simple. Acceptance criteria: – Smooth 3D animation that runs at 24 fps or higher. – Colour palette and character styling appropriate for a teenage audience (think modern cartoons on streaming platforms). – Runtime in the 2–3 minute range unless our concept clearly needs more or less. – At least one revision cycle after I review the first full render. If you love crafting engaging 3D worlds and know what keeps teens glued to the screen, I’d like to collaborate and get this animated short ready to share.

opportunities.title: Sonic Boom Reduction Analysis: Concorde CFD Simulation
opportunities.description: ANSYS Fluent CFD Simulation – Concorde Nose Geometry Modification for Sonic Boom Reduction Project Overview I am looking for an experienced Aerospace Engineer or CFD Specialist to assist with my undergraduate graduation project, which investigates the effect of nose geometry modifications on sonic boom generation in a supersonic aircraft, using the Concorde as a case study. The project will use ANSYS Workbench and ANSYS Fluent to simulate supersonic flow around a simplified Concorde-like aircraft geometry and investigate how different nose shapes affect shock waves, pressure signatures, and aerodynamic performance. Two research papers and my graduation project proposal will be provided as technical references. Scope of Work 1. Geometry Preparation * Prepare or modify a simplified Concorde-like 3D aircraft geometry. * Create a baseline configuration and several modified nose geometries. * Investigate selected nose parameters, such as nose length, bluntness, and nose radius. * Prepare the geometry for CFD simulations in ANSYS Workbench. 2. Computational Domain and Mesh Generation * Create a suitable computational domain for supersonic external flow. * Generate an appropriate mesh to capture shock waves and pressure gradients around the aircraft nose. * Apply local mesh refinement in critical regions. * Perform mesh quality checks and, where feasible, a mesh-independence study. * Explain the selected mesh strategy and boundary conditions. 3. ANSYS Fluent Simulations * Set up and run compressible supersonic flow simulations. * Use appropriate operating conditions based on the provided research papers and project proposal. * Select suitable governing equations, air properties, pressure-based or density-based solver settings, and numerical schemes as appropriate for the problem. * Evaluate an appropriate turbulence model or inviscid Euler approach, with technical justification. * Obtain converged and physically meaningful solutions for the baseline and modified configurations. 4. Results and Comparative Analysis * Generate Mach number contours and static pressure contours. * Visualize shock waves and compare their locations and strengths. * Extract pressure distributions and near-field pressure signatures at suitable locations. * Calculate and compare aerodynamic coefficients, including drag coefficient (CD) and lift coefficient (CL) where applicable. * Compare all nose configurations against the baseline geometry. * Discuss the trade-off between sonic boom-related pressure characteristics and aerodynamic performance. 5. Sonic Boom Propagation – If Feasible * Assess whether the extracted near-field pressure signatures can be used with an appropriate sonic boom propagation tool, such as NASA PC-Boom or another suitable validated method. * If this stage is included, provide the required input data, propagation results, and a comparison of ground-level pressure signatures. * Clearly identify any limitations or additional software requirements. Required Deliverables 1. ANSYS Workbench project files and Fluent case/data files. 2. Baseline and modified CAD geometry files. 3. Mesh files and documented mesh settings. 4. Simulation results for all agreed configurations. 5. High-quality plots, contours, and comparison graphs. 6. A technical report describing the methodology, solver setup, boundary conditions, mesh strategy, convergence, results, and conclusions. 7. A short explanation of how to open the project and reproduce the simulations. Required Qualifications * Demonstrated experience with ANSYS Fluent and ANSYS Workbench. * Strong background in aerospace CFD and compressible flow. * Experience with supersonic or hypersonic flow and shock-wave analysis. * Familiarity with CFD mesh generation, convergence assessment, and aerodynamic coefficient calculations. * Experience with sonic boom prediction or aeroacoustic pressure-signature analysis is highly desirable. Important Notes Please review the attached proposal and research papers before submitting your offer. In your proposal, please specify: * Your relevant ANSYS Fluent and supersonic CFD experience. * The proposed simulation methodology and software requirements. * The number of geometries and simulation cases included in your price. * The expected computational requirements and estimated completion time. * Which deliverables are included in your offer. * Whether sonic boom propagation to ground level is included or quoted separately. Please provide examples of relevant previous CFD projects, if available. The work should be technically sound, reproducible, and suitable for an undergraduate aerospace engineering graduation project. I also need to understand the methodology and results so I can explain and defend the project academically.

opportunities.title: Medal.tv Mass-Report Automation
opportunities.description: I need a Windows-compatible utility that lets me load a list of Medal.tv clip URLs— whether they come from a CSV or a simple text file— and then walks through the site’s report flow for each link. Here’s what I expect it to do: • Read every URL, open it in a headless (or visible) browser session, and launch Medal’s reporting interface. • For the violation type, give me a smart helper: predefined rules can pre-select “Hate speech” or “Unauthorized voice recording” when the text on the page matches, yet still pause so I can confirm or override before the report is submitted. • Submit exactly one legitimate report per clip while staying within Medal’s own rate limits and general reporting guidelines. • Track progress locally— a simple CSV or log is fine— noting success, any errors, and preventing duplicates if I re-run the list. The finished deliverable should be a reusable EXE or bundled script with straightforward setup, along with a quick proof-of-concept demo (screen capture or short call) that shows it reliably reporting at least one clip. Source code is welcome but not required if the compiled build is stable. Preferred stack: Python + Selenium or Playwright, but I’m open to alternatives if they meet the goals above.

opportunities.title: YouTube Kids Animation Partner Needed
opportunities.description: My new children’s content brand is about to launch on YouTube, built around original characters who help kids understand emotions through engaging stories. The channel will release one 4-to-6-minute episode every single day, so the core of this job is establishing a fast, reliable animation-editing pipeline that can scale without sacrificing charm. The visual approach is still open—I’m weighing 2D against a streamlined 3D workflow and welcome guidance from someone fluent in both. A small library of rigs, backgrounds, and audio beds is ready, yet each story arc may call for fresh assets or subtle refinements to the existing ones. You’ll be animating, editing, adding sound effects and music, and handing back polished HD files that are upload-ready. Daily deliverables • Final MP4 (4–6 min, 1080p or higher) • Thumbnail frame plus any new assets created • Source project files (After Effects, Premiere, Blender, etc.) Acceptance criteria • Expressive, on-model character acting that clearly conveys the featured emotion • Smooth lip-sync and clean audio mix • Visual consistency with brand colours and model sheets • Episode length within 4–6 minutes, delivered before the agreed upload window We’ll review workflow and performance monthly as part of what’s intended to be a long-term partnership. Communication will happen through Slack and shared cloud storage. Please include a reel that shows your best 2D and/or 3D work for young audiences and a brief note on which pipeline you believe will best support a daily release schedule.

opportunities.title: n8n WhatsApp Auto-Messaging Setup
opportunities.description: I need an n8n workflow that connects to my WhatsApp Business account and fires off automated messages without manual intervention. The goal is to handle three use-cases—promotions, time-sensitive notifications, and gentle reminders—while pulling in personalized user data so every chat feels 1-to-1 rather than a blast. Here is what I have in mind: • The trigger can be either a webhook, a schedule, or a call from an existing REST endpoint—whichever you feel is the cleanest way to pass user-specific variables such as name, order number, or appointment date into the workflow. • n8n should then format the message, inject the variables, and hit the WhatsApp Business API (or your preferred gateway) to send it. • I’d like a simple success/fail log so I can track delivery and catch any API errors quickly. You’re free to suggest nodes, credentials handling, or helper services that keep the setup lightweight and secure. Once complete, I’ll need the .json export of the workflow plus a brief step-by-step so I can replicate it in another instance. If you have previous experience combining n8n with WhatsApp, especially for personalized campaigns, let’s talk details and timelines. Project: FlexiFunnels + Meta WhatsApp Cloud API + n8n Scope: - Set up official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API using our business-owned accounts - Create a secure n8n production webhook and connect the FlexiFunnels registration form - Capture WhatsApp consent and validate name and phone number - Send an approved registration-confirmation template - Test a reminder workflow using a confirmed event date and time - Track delivery failures, prevent duplicate sends and document troubleshooting - Provide exported n8n workflows, setup documentation and a handover session Please provide a fixed-price quote, delivery timeline, relevant portfolio, support period, and acceptance criteria. All Meta and n8n accounts must remain under our ownership. Funnels registration → WhatsApp confirmation → scheduled reminders → post-masterclass follow-up.

Use it as a reference to understand the project concept and my vision for the final website. I am looking for an experienced web designer and developer to transform this concept into a stunning, premium-quality 3D solar energy website with a modern, futuristic, and luxurious look. ## Project Vision The goal is to build a world-class solar energy website that stands out from ordinary solar business websites. I want an immersive, high-end digital experience featuring cinematic visuals, interactive 3D elements, smooth animations, and exceptional UI/UX design. The demo website is provided as a starting reference. I want the final website to be significantly more polished, visually impressive, interactive, and professional. ## Key Requirements - **Premium UI/UX Design:** Modern, elegant layouts with sophisticated typography, beautiful spacing, and a consistent visual identity. - **Immersive 3D Experience:** High-quality 3D solar panels, rooftop solar installations, realistic lighting, interactive models, and cinematic visual effects. - **Smooth Animations:** Scroll-triggered animations, fluid transitions, parallax effects, and engaging micro-interactions. - **Stunning Homepage:** A visually striking hero section with bold typography, premium visuals, and compelling calls to action. - **Essential Pages:** Home, About Us, Solar Solutions/Services, Projects, and Contact. - **Lead Generation:** Professional contact forms, quote request forms, WhatsApp integration, and clear call-to-action buttons. - **Fully Responsive:** Excellent performance and design across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. - **Performance Optimization:** Fast loading, optimized 3D assets, SEO-friendly structure, and smooth scrolling. - **Premium Visual Identity:** A sophisticated color palette, cinematic lighting, modern layouts, and attention to every detail. ## Preferred Technologies React, Next.js, Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, or other suitable modern technologies that can deliver an outstanding 3D web experience. opportunities.title: 3D Steering Arm CAD Model
opportunities.description: I need a production-ready 3D model of a single steering arm together with a fully dimensioned 2-D part drawing. Scope The upright side of the arm must follow my bolt pattern; I will supply the exact PCD and bolt sizes once the project starts. On the opposite end I want a rod-end seat for the tie-rod, not a simple drilled hole or spherical bearing cup. The default material should be EN24 steel—please confirm its suitability or suggest an equivalent grade before finalising wall thicknesses and radii. Design guidance • Keep weight down with sensible pockets, generous fillets and absolutely no sharp inside corners in high-stress areas. • Maintain adequate clearance for typical ½-in rod ends; confirm final seat diameter with me. • Preserve the bolt head and tool access around the mounting pattern. Deliverables 1. Native CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or Creo) plus a STEP file. 2. Detailed 2-D drawing with all critical dimensions, tolerances, thread specs and material call-out. 3. Mass and basic FEA screenshots or hand calculations showing the design meets typical steering loads (static 12 kN radial as a reference). Acceptance The job is complete when the model assembles with my upright and tie-rod library parts without interference, the drawing is clear enough for CNC machining, and material + weight targets are met.

opportunities.title: Modern Lightweight E-Commerce Redesign for Performance
opportunities.description: My current e-commerce site delivers its products well, yet the pages feel heavy and they fail to clear Google PageSpeed Insights with the scores I need. I want the entire front-end rebuilt into a clean, modern interface while keeping the existing logo and colour scheme intact. Everything else is open to refinement as long as the end result loads fast, looks contemporary on every device and converts shoppers smoothly. Key objectives • Replace the present theme with a light, standards-compliant layout that scores 90+ on both mobile and desktop PageSpeed tests. • Preserve brand recognition by re-using the current logo and colour palette, but refresh typography, spacing and visual hierarchy for a modern feel. • Optimise images, scripts and CSS, introduce lazy-loading where appropriate and eliminate render-blocking resources. • Ensure every product, cart and checkout view remains fully functional and responsive down to small screens. Deliverables 1. Fully coded theme or template files ready to drop into the existing e-commerce platform (please indicate in your proposal which stack you prefer to work with). 2. opportunities.title: Senior International BDM – BI & Analytics | Growth-Oriented | 100% Remote | Flexible Hours | 1-3 Months Evaluation Period | Opportunity for Permanent Employment
opportunities.description: Senior International Business Development Manager – BI & Analytics Sales 100% Remote | Flexible Hours | 1-3 Month Evaluation Period | Opportunity for Permanent Employment Join us in an exciting opportunity to spearhead global client acquisition for cutting-edge IT Reporting & Analytics solutions. This is your chance to grow professionally and earn while working flexibly from anywhere in the world. What You'll Sell: Power BI & Tableau dashboards, BI solutions, MIS reporting, data analytics, reporting automation, and data engineering services. Target Market: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Europe. Your Role: Take ownership of generating leads, approaching international clients, building a sales pipeline, developing relationships, negotiating deals, and closing high-value projects. The role focuses heavily on lead generation and client acquisition across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Europe. Earning Potential: - Project Value up to $25000: 8% commission on project value + 10% performance incentive on the commission earned. - Projects Value from $25,001 to $60,000: 10% commission + 15% performance incentive on the commission earned + an additional $250 reward. - Projects Value above $60,000: 10% commission + 20% performance incentive on the commission earned + an additional $1000 reward. Benefits to You: - Work fully remotely with flexible hours tailored to your lifestyle. - Unlimited earning potential based on performance—sky’s the limit on commissions! - Build your career while driving value by selling best-in-class BI products. Key Engagement Terms: - Initial 3 months: 100% commission-based with No fixed salary: There is no guaranteed monthly income, advance payment, or upfront lead-generation or setup fee during the commission-only period. - Develop business from scratch without an established sales pipeline—you are setting the foundation for success! - Commission will be calculated on eligible project revenue actually received by company, excluding applicable taxes and refunds. -Commission eligibility will be based on projects successfully secured through the candidate's business development efforts, subject to the agreed terms. Early Transition to Permanent Employment: - Early Transition: High-performing candidates may qualify for permanent employment from the second month onwards by achieving agreed first-month sales targets, successfully closing projects, meeting client payment requirements, and satisfying the company's performance criteria. - Three-Month Evaluation: Candidates who do not qualify for early transition may continue under the initial three-month commission-only evaluation period, - Permanent Employment Benefits: Upon written confirmation of permanent employment, eligible candidates may receive a mutually agreed fixed salary, performance incentives, applicable benefits, and a $1,000 joining bonus, subject to agreed eligibility conditions. Note:- $1,000 Joining Bonus: Eligible candidates achieving $30,000 in qualifying sales during Month 1 or $80,000 cumulatively over 3 months may qualify for the joining bonus, subject to performance criteria and written confirmation. This role is for driven professionals ready to embrace challenges and create growth opportunities. Apply only if you understand and accept the initial commission-only arrangement during the first three months.

opportunities.title: Testing and Commissioning of Data Center Systems
opportunities.description: Data Center BMS, EPMS, SCADA & PLC Testing and Commissioning Project Overview I successfully executed testing, commissioning, and system integration activities for Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and automation architectures in data center projects. My responsibilities included system configuration, troubleshooting, functional testing, and coordination with multidisciplinary teams to ensure reliable system operation and successful project delivery. Roles & Responsibilities 1. BMS & EPMS Testing and Commissioning Performed onsite system delivery, testing, and commissioning of BMS, EPMS, and automation systems for data center projects, ensuring compliance with project requirements and operational expectations. 2. SCADA, HMI & PLC Configuration Executed programming modifications, system debugging, and configuration of SCADA, HMI, and PLC interfaces to maintain system stability and ensure reliable operation. 3. Electrical Installation Verification Verified electrical installations against control schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications. Identified and resolved onsite technical issues to minimize delays and maintain project schedules. 4. FAT, SAT & System Integration Coordination Coordinated with clients, engineering teams, and subcontractors throughout Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and system integration activities. 5. Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis Supported troubleshooting of control and instrumentation issues by performing fault finding, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to restore system functionality and prevent recurring faults. 6. Functional & Integrated Systems Testing Conducted functional testing to verify that electrical and control systems operated as intended, as well as integration testing to confirm proper interaction between electrical systems and other data center systems. 7. Communication Protocol Verification Worked with common building and industrial communication protocols, including BACnet, Modbus, RS-232/RS-485 serial communication, and TCP/IP, to support system connectivity and integration. 8. Technical Documentation & Project Handover Prepared and finalized commissioning reports, test records, troubleshooting logs, and technical documentation to support project handover and operational readiness. Key Contributions - Supported reliable operation of critical data center electrical monitoring and building automation systems. - Improved system readiness through structured testing, troubleshooting, and verification activities. - Helped resolve onsite technical issues through coordination with clients, engineering teams, and subcontractors. - Contributed to successful commissioning, system integration, and project handover. Technical Skills BMS | EPMS | SCADA | HMI | PLC | Data Center Systems | Testing & Commissioning | FAT | SAT | Integrated Systems Testing | Electrical Schematics | Troubleshooting | Root Cause Analysis | BACnet | Modbus | RS-232/RS-485 | TCP/IP

opportunities.title: Technical & Behavioral Interviewer
opportunities.description: Start with "I am not a bot" in your proposal, others will ignore. American, European English or Spanish tutors are prefered. My software engineering team is growing fast and I want an experienced interviewer who can confidently evaluate both the hard and soft skills of our candidates. You will cover two dimensions in every session. First, the behavioral side: I need you to probe leadership and teamwork in real depth—how applicants motivate peers, resolve conflict, and share ownership. While that is the priority, feel free to note any impressive problem-solving or communication traits you see along the way. Second, the technical side: the conversation should centre on software testing and quality assurance. Discuss unit, integration, automation, CI/CD, code coverage, and overall test strategy so we can gauge a candidate’s quality mindset. Familiarity with programming languages or system design is welcome, but your credibility in QA is what really matters. Typical flow • I send you the résumé and role description. • You design a 45-60 minute interview tailored to the candidate. • You run the call on Zoom or Google Meet. • Within 24 hours you send structured feedback and a clear hire/no-hire recommendation. Deliverables for each candidate - Interview question set and brief rationale - Scoring rubric with weighted criteria - Written feedback summary and recommendation Please let me know about your prior interviewing experience, QA expertise, and timezone availability so we can start scheduling right away.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40779602, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Advanced English Tutor For Developers
opportunities.description: Please start from "I am not a bot" in your bid. Don't bid Indian, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Venezuela, Iran, Asian countries. North, South American, Europe countries are prefered. I coordinate a fast-growing software team made up of new hires from several Asian countries, and I want each developer to feel just as confident in everyday English conversations as they are in code from next month or next year. To make that happen I am looking for a tutor with proven, advanced-level teaching expertise who can run regular one-on-one lessons focused on General English. Here is what I have in mind: • One-to-one sessions delivered online at times that can accommodate multiple time zones across Asia. • A practical, spoken-first approach that targets listening, pronunciation and day-to-day workplace communication rather than heavy grammar theory. • Brief post-lesson notes or recordings so participants can review key points and track progress week by week. Familiarity with technology-oriented learners is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take absolute beginners through to comfortable conversational fluency. If you can outline your typical teaching framework, suggested cadence and the tools you use (Zoom, Google Classroom, interactive whiteboards, etc.), that will help me select the best fit quickly. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on a schedule, so please share your experience, a sample lesson plan and any success stories with similar students.

opportunities.title: ManageEngine NPM Setup & Tuning
opportunities.description: Job Summary We are looking for experienced ManageEngine Consultants with hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, administering, and supporting ManageEngine IT management solutions. The ideal candidate should have experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT infrastructure monitoring, endpoint management, or identity and access management using relevant ManageEngine products. Key Responsibilities Implement, configure, and maintain ManageEngine products based on business and IT requirements. Manage IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including incident, problem, change, and service request management. Configure workflows, automation rules, service catalogs, SLAs, dashboards, and reports. Administer user accounts, roles, permissions, and access controls. Monitor IT infrastructure, networks, servers, applications, and endpoints, depending on the product deployed. Integrate ManageEngine solutions with Active Directory, Microsoft 365, email systems, and other enterprise applications. Troubleshoot technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and provide timely resolutions. Support upgrades, patch management, system performance optimization, and product maintenance. Prepare technical documentation, user guides, and configuration reports. Coordinate with IT teams, stakeholders, and vendors to ensure smooth operations.

opportunities.title: Animación 3D de Vivienda Moderna -- 2
opportunities.description: Quiero transformar mi proyecto residencial en una animación 3D fluida y atractiva que muestre cada detalle de un diseño de estilo moderno. La vivienda ya está modelada; lo que necesito ahora es una secuencia animada que recorra todos los espacios — sala de estar, cocina, dormitorio principal y el resto de la casa — con una narrativa visual que permita apreciar materiales, iluminación y distribución. Busco a alguien que se mueva con soltura en herramientas como 3ds Max, Blender o similares, y que domine motores de render como V-Ray, Corona o Lumion para lograr acabados realistas. Me interesa un resultado cinematográfico, con transiciones suaves, luz natural convincente y algún detalle de animación de mobiliario o accesorios para dar vida al ambiente. Entregables clave: • Video final en resolución Full HD (idealmente también versión 4K) • Archivo de proyecto editable o set de fotogramas si es necesario realizar ajustes posteriores • Una captura fija de cada estancia principal para material promocional Aprecio la comunicación clara durante el proceso: storyboard o previz inicial, un primer corte para feedback y la versión final con ajustes de color y música ambiental ligera. Si tienes ejemplos de recorridos virtuales previos, enlázalos en tu propuesta; será un plus para decidir.

opportunities.title: Cancún - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 3
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar dos cotizaciones de manera presencial en dos empresas asignadas por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en las empresas y sucursales asignadas para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado a cada sucursal, 2 a 3 horas en total) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos por sucursal, 1 a 2 horas en total). En total se requieren de 4 a 6 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $100 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Cancún. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $100 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $100 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Asistente Virtual Bilingüe Experto
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente virtual con nivel experto que se encargue de tres frentes clave dentro de mi negocio: • Atención al cliente – Responder consultas por correo y chat, gestionar tickets y mantener un tono cordial y resolutivo tanto en español como en inglés. • Gestión de correos – Organizar la bandeja de entrada, filtrar mensajes prioritarios, redactar respuestas, programar seguimientos y archivar correos según etiquetas predeterminadas. • Investigación en línea – Recopilar datos sobre competidores, oportunidades de mercado y mejores prácticas, presentándome resúmenes claros y fuentes verificables. Trabajo principalmente con Gmail, Google Workspace, hojas de cálculo y un CRM tipo HubSpot; confío en que te desenvuelvas fluidamente en herramientas similares. Necesito: – Disponibilidad de lunes a viernes en horario latinoamericano. – Tiempo de respuesta máximo de 2 horas en consultas internas. – Un breve informe semanal con métricas de tickets cerrados, correos gestionados y hallazgos de investigación. Si dominas la comunicación bilingüe, eres proactivo y ya manejas flujos de atención al cliente de alto volumen, estarás en tu zona de confort. Cuéntame tu experiencia, tus casos de éxito y la metodología que seguirías para arrancar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Representante Comercial para Software ERP Inmobiliario
opportunities.description: Buscamos socio comercial freelance para vender software ERP inmobiliario En Digitech Group Perú hemos desarrollado **Syncro, un ERP diseñado para empresas inmobiliarias**, que permite centralizar procesos administrativos y financieros, automatizar operaciones y tener mayor control del negocio. Estamos buscando un **representante comercial independiente** que nos ayude a conseguir nuevos clientes en Lima y otras ciudades del Perú. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia en ventas B2B, preferiblemente de software, ERP o soluciones tecnológicas. - Capacidad para identificar inmobiliarias, contactar a sus gerentes y generar oportunidades comerciales. - Habilidad para presentar propuestas, hacer seguimiento y cerrar ventas. ¿Cómo trabajaremos? La modalidad es freelance y basada en resultados: **no hay una mensualidad fija; la remuneración será mediante comisiones por cada cliente que contrate Syncro y realice el pago correspondiente. Nosotros nos encargamos de las demostraciones técnicas, la implementación y el soporte del sistema. El socio comercial se enfoca en generar oportunidades y concretar las ventas. Si tienes experiencia comercial y te interesa trabajar con un producto tecnológico propio, nos gustaría conversar contigo. Para postular, envíanos tu experiencia en ventas B2B, los sectores con los que has trabajado y tu propuesta de comisión.

opportunities.title: Business Lead Generator for Digital Studio
opportunities.description: Looking for a Business Development / Lead Generation freelancer for my creative digital studio, Ventex Creations (Pune, India). We build websites, run social media, design brands, and shoot photo/video for startups and local businesses. What you'll do: - Find startups and businesses that need our services - Reach out by call, email, LinkedIn, or WhatsApp - Book meetings between the client and me (I handle the pitch and delivery) - Track your leads in a simple spreadsheet Pay: - Then 10% commission on every project you bring in (uncapped) - 10% of retainer payments for the first 3 months - Commission is paid when the client pays us Requirements: - Experience in B2B outreach, cold email, LinkedIn, or cold calling - Clear written communication - Hindi or English for calling businesses is a big plus - Part-time, flexible hours To apply, tell me in 2-3 lines how you would find your first 10 clients for a web and design studio, and confirm that you're fine with the commission structure.
